verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents OpenAI-compatible APIs and drop-in replacement for OpenAI (fireworks-ai-docs-36, fireworks-ai-docs-15). It also documents OpenAI-compatible tool specifications for building agents (fireworks-ai-docs-42). Its homepage pitches cutting AI coding spend as a drop-in replacement (fireworks-ai-docs-11). Together this implies you could point a coding agent or agent framework at it, but the pack contains no actual first-party integration guide for any named coding agent or framework. missing for 10: named first-party integration guides for coding agents (e.g., setup docs for specific IDE/CLI agents), agent-framework integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of these integrations working.
